Senses.Explanation: A fixed expanse formula that totals the whole made world for one gesture to handle. Yunmen Wenyan points with his staff and gathers the buddhas of every dust of the whole expanse inside it, daring anyone to stop them trading wins, Fenyang Shanzhao tells them it arises where they stand and shows itself where they look, the whole expanse bright and clear, Xuedou Chongxian turns every grass and tree of the expanse into one patched monk whose hundred thousand questions one finger-flick of the elder dismisses, Chijue Daochong shrinks the whole expanse to less than a hair's tip while the staff-bearers tramp four worlds claiming nowhere unreached, and Wu'an Puning pierces the eyes of the buddhas and ancestors with one stroke of his staff, leaving the whole expanse without a hair-tip of leak. Chushi Fanqi asks what single thing of the whole expanse ever tied itself to a person and dares anyone to fetch him a needle-tip of it, Yunfeng Wenyue holds color and emptiness, the feeling and the unfeeling, all inside the mountain monk, Shishuang Chuyuan lifts his staff crosswise to pick up the whole expanse and turns the bowl to cover the Ganges-sands world, Zhe'an Jingfan faults the Shaoyang old man for looking only ahead, then sets the ten directions, the expanse, and all the old masters back each in place, and Zhulang Chesheng names the whole expanse the vajra body itself, whose every dust and land is the light it always owned.
